 Order

This second application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.134/2022 registered at Police Station Badagaon District Tikamgarh for the offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Earlier application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive the prayer after filing of the charge sheet vide order dated 14/11/2022.
Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 20/10/2022.
He further submits that the present applicant is sister-in-law (Nanad) of the deceased.
The relation between the applicant and deceased were not co-ordinal and they used to fight against each other.

He further submits that there was no allegation of demand of dowry and merely because death has occurred within seven years of the marriage, the present applicant cannot be implicated under the offence of Section 304-B of IPC.
He further submits that the present applicant is a lady aged about 22 years.

sentences.text: On these submissions, he prays that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

On the other hand, counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that in view of the material available in the case diary and the allegation attributed against the applicant, she is not entitled to be released on bail.
Considering the submissions made by the counsel for the parties and after perusal of case diary, I am inclined to consider and allow this bail application.
Therefore, without commenting anything on merit, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.
